content.text:
if lf < 0 or lf + 1 > terminator:
                raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
            if lf == pos or data[lf - 1] != 0x0D:
                raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
            content_length = lf - 1 - pos
            if content_length > 8192:
                raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
            next_global = header_start + lf + 1
            if next_global - block_start > 65536:
                raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
            content = data[pos:lf - 1]
            if content == b"":
                return headers, next_global
            if len(headers) + 1 > 128:
                raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
            headers.append(_field(content))
            pos = lf + 1
    return _header_block_slow(cap, block_start, header_start)

def _parse_request(cap: Capture, start: int, state: _AuditState):
    content, cursor = _line(cap, start)
    method, target = _request_line(content)
    block_start = start
    if cursor - block_start > 65536:
        raise _ParseFailure("syntax")

    headers, cursor = _header_block_fast(cap, block_start, cursor)

    framing, body_length = _framing(headers)
    body_fp = (0, 0)
    trailers_fp = _fields_fingerprint([])

    if framing == "none":
        end = cursor
    elif framing == "length":
        body_start = cursor
        if cap.total - body_start < body_length:
            raise _ParseFailure("incomplete")
        end = body_start + body_length
        body_fp = cap.fp_range(body_start, end)
    else:  # chunked
        body_total = 0
        end = cursor
        trailers = []
        while True:
            content, next_cursor = _line(cap, cursor)
            # The budget counts a line only after its CRLF and line-limit
            # checks, and before inspecting the hexadecimal size or suffix.
            state.chunk_lines += 1
            if state.chunk_lines > 40000:
                raise ValueError("chunk line budget")
            chunk_length = _chunk_size(content)
            cursor = next_cursor

            if chunk_length == 0:
                trailer_start = cursor
                while True:
                    content, next_cursor = _line(cap, cursor)
                    if next_cursor - trailer_start > 65536:
                        raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
                    if content == b"":
                        cursor = next_cursor
                        break
                    if len(trailers) + 1 > 128:
                        raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
                    field = _field(content)
                    if field[0].lower() in _FORBIDDEN_TRAILER_NAMES:
                        raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
                    trailers.append(field)
                    cursor = next_cursor
                trailers_fp = _fields_fingerprint(trailers)
                end = cursor
                break

            if body_total + chunk_length > MAX:
                raise ValueError("body length budget")
            data_start = cursor
            if cap.total - data_start < chunk_length:
                raise _ParseFailure("incomplete")
            data_end = data_start + chunk_length
            if cap.total - data_end < 2:
                raise _ParseFailure("incomplete")
            if cap.read(data_end, data_end + 2) != b"\r\n":
                raise _ParseFailure("syntax")
            body_fp = _combine_fp(body_fp, cap.fp_range(data_start, data_end))
            body_total += chunk_length
            cursor = data_end + 2

    host_values = [value for name, value in headers
                   if name.lower() == b"host"]
    host_count = len(host_values)
    if host_count == 1:
        host_value = host_values[0].lower()
        host_fp = fingerprint_bytes(host_value)
    else:
        host_value = b""
        host_fp = fingerprint_bytes(b"")

    owner = cap.owner_at(start)
    owners = cap.owners_for(start, end)
    return _Parsed(
        start=start,
        end=end,
        method=method,
        target=target,
        host_value=host_value,
        host_count=host_count,
        headers_fp=_fields_fingerprint(headers),
        body_fp=_fp_object(body_fp),
        trailers_fp=trailers_fp,
        framing=framing,
        owner=owner,
        owners=owners,
    ), end
